analysis.rationale: Double-digit revenue and profit growth with margin expansion, supported by operating leverage and new high-value contracts like a US umbrella supplier. The company is listed on BSE SME and has a strong growth trajectory.
analysis.summary: Sampark India Logistics reported FY26 revenue of ₹223.3 Cr (+11% YoY), EBITDA of ₹20.0 Cr (+23%), PAT of ₹10.5 Cr (+26%), with EBITDA margin expanding 90 bps to 9.0% and PAT margin improving to 4.7%.
